name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop
description: Electron desktop shell: bundled Node runs dsh web, the window loads its loopback UI
author: DeepSeek

scripts.pack: pnpm run build:shell && pnpm run stage && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.pack:mac: pnpm run build:shell && pnpm run stage && electron-builder --mac dmg --publish never
scripts.pack:win: pnpm run build:shell && tsx scripts/stage-runtime.ts --platform win32 --arch x64 && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never
